package closures

func counter() func() int {
	count := 0
	return func() int {
		count++
		return count
	}
}

func apply(values []int) int {
	sum := 0
	add := func(a int) {
		sum += a
	}
	for _, v := range values {
		add(v)
	}
	defer func() {
		_ = recover()
	}()
	go func(n int) { sum += n }(1)
	return sum
}
